summary.text: Jeff Leach is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 67 who has represented the district since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Leach took office in the Texas House on January 8, 2013.
Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Judiciary & Civil Jurisprudence Committee from 2019 through 2024, and as a member of the Criminal Jurisprudence Committee in 2023-2024.
He advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.
